newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Office files for 30 million shares.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Office files for 30 million shares.

text.p: U.S. Office Products Co said it filed a shelf registration for 30 million shares of common stock and it has recently completed 10 acquisitions.

The company, in a press release Tuesday, said the shelf registration, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission, allows it to have enough shares to continue processing its acquisition backlog without continually filing with the SEC for each purchase.

The company also recently received a $500 million credit facility from Bankers Trust Co to fund, among other things, the cash portion of its acquisitions. U.S. Office said its acquisitions are historically for 65 percent stock and 35 percent cash.

U.S. Office, a contract stationer, was started in October, 1994 to create a nationwide office products supplier, primarly for corporate and commercial customers. To date, the company has completed 98 acquisitions.
Its most recent included operations in Texas, Ohio, Tennessee, Canada and Alabama. It operates in 34 states, New Zealand and Australia.
